lead_independence.headline: Tiger Woods pleads no contest to reckless driving in Martin County crash, receives $1,500 in fines and five-year license suspension
lead_independence.lead: Tiger Woods pleaded no contest to reckless driving and refusal to submit to a lawful test Wednesday in Martin County Court in connection with his March 27 rollover crash on Jupiter Island, avoiding the DUI charges he initially faced. Woods was sentenced to a $1,000 fine for reckless driving, a $500 fine for the refusal charge, and an additional fine for careless driving, with his license suspended for five years. He had previously entered a not guilty plea to misdemeanor charges of DUI with property damage and refusal to submit to a lawful test.
